title: Tooltips show the key in keycaps
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation and rest the pointer on the reply arrow in the open message's header
Move straight to Reply All, then Forward
Rest on the small chevron after the recipients and click it
expected: After about half a second a dark pill (light in Dark) shows the action and its key in keycaps (Reply R, Reply All A, Forward F). The next button's tip shows at once. The chevron's tip says Show details with no key; a click shows the From, To and date block. One tip at a time, inside the window, never over its button.
